info.title: aimem hub API
info.description: The complete HTTP surface of an aimem hub (and of the local service, which serves the same mux over a unix socket without auth). Every route except the three public pages (/, /v1/status, /admin) requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; routes marked x-role admin additionally need an admin token (the env token, or a tokens.json entry with role admin). This spec documents the surface and its auth contract; request/response bodies are intentionally loose (JSON objects) - the store types in internal/store are the authority on field shapes. A parity test (openapi_test.go) fails CI when this file and the real route table disagree.

get.summary: List users, access groups, membership, grants, ordinary-token metadata and the last 100 administration audit events

200.description: Access snapshot; no secrets or token digests

get.summary: Inspect authenticated identity and current task-write permission for an optional project
get.description: Also available to ordinary user tokens. Ordinary tokens may additionally use the task routes and /mcp task tools; they are refused on every other non-public endpoint. Legacy writer/admin credentials retain their existing rights. With ?project=<id>, every credential also receives tasks_enabled: whether an admin has switched tasks on for that project (task mutations are refused with 403 otherwise).

200.description: Identity including ordinary token scope (user, project or read-only), task_write scope/grant eligibility, and separate tasks_enabled setting

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

get.summary: List a project's epics (OPEN unless include_retired=true)
get.description: Ordinary user tokens may call this route. An epic is the grouping above tasks that a release or milestone maps to.

post.summary: Create an epic
post.description: Body: title (required), objective, target, state (OPEN by default). Authorized like a task write in this project (ordinary user-scoped or matching project-scoped token with a current grant, or admin; tasks must be enabled). Retry keys travel in the Idempotency-Key header.

403.description: not authorized or tasks not enabled

get.summary: Read one epic
get.description: Ordinary user tokens may call this route.

put.summary: Replace an epic's fields under expected_revision; state RETIRED retires it
put.description: Authorized like a task write. A stale expected_revision returns 409 with the current epic. Retirement keeps existing task assignments and refuses new ones; ids are never reused.

409.description: revision conflict, current epic in the body

get.summary: The identity directory: id, kind, name and enabled of every user and group
get.description: Ordinary user tokens may call this route: it is what the task page labels assignees and comment authors with. Nothing else about an identity is returned (no tokens, grants or project lists); effective permissions stay in the access store.

get.summary: The project's selected process reference (repository, ref, commit, manifest)
get.description: Ordinary user tokens may call this route: the reference is what an agent needs to find the project's process documents and grants no access to the repository. 404 when nothing is selected; ?history=1 adds the retained earlier selections, newest first, and answers 200 even when nothing is selected now.

put.summary: Select or clear the project's process reference (admin)
put.description: Body: repo (https/ssh/git@ URL), commit (full 40-hex), manifest (relative path in the repository), optional ref (branch or tag for servers that refuse fetch-by-hash), and expected_commit — the commit currently selected, empty when none — or the write is refused with 409 and the current selection. {"clear":true,"expected_commit":...} clears. Every selection is retained in the project's history.

409.description: expected_commit does not match the current selection

get.summary: List task summaries of a project
get.description: Archived tasks are excluded unless include_archived=true. Pages default 20, max 100; pass next_cursor as after. Ordinary user tokens may call this route; writes are authorized per attempt against the task's owning project (user-scoped token or token issued for that project instance, plus a current grant), legacy writer tokens read only, admin tokens do everything.

400.description: Validation failure (bad cursor, limit or filter)

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

post.summary: Create a task in an existing ordinary project
post.description: Body is the editable content (title required; state defaults to BACKLOG; candidate_refs and evidence_refs are typed references {kind, ref, note?, scope?} with kind one of task, doc, record, commit, pr, ci, url, text — a bare string is refused with 400 since schema 13). Never creates a project. Ordinary user tokens may call this route; writes are authorized per attempt against the task's owning project (user-scoped token or token issued for that project instance, plus a current grant), legacy writer tokens read only, admin tokens do everything. Retry keys travel in the Idempotency-Key header.

400.description: Validation failure (bounds, unknown field, missing Idempotency-Key, reserved project)

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

403.description: Credential may not write tasks in this project

409.description: Revision conflict (body carries current), idempotency key reused with different input, or archived task

get.summary: Read one task
get.description: Current content, revision, owning project (resolved at read time, so a rename is reflected) and origin-relative links. Ordinary user tokens may call this route; writes are authorized per attempt against the task's owning project (user-scoped token or token issued for that project instance, plus a current grant), legacy writer tokens read only, admin tokens do everything.

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

put.summary: Replace a task's editable fields under expected-revision CAS
put.description: Body is the full editable content plus expected_revision; omitted optional fields clear (candidate_refs and evidence_refs are typed references {kind, ref, note?, scope?} — a bare string is refused with 400 since schema 13). A stale revision answers 409 with the current task. Ordinary user tokens may call this route; writes are authorized per attempt against the task's owning project (user-scoped token or token issued for that project instance, plus a current grant), legacy writer tokens read only, admin tokens do everything. Retry keys travel in the Idempotency-Key header.

400.description: Validation failure (bounds, unknown field, missing Idempotency-Key, reserved project)

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

403.description: Credential may not write tasks in this project

409.description: Revision conflict (body carries `current` in the same shape as a read), idempotency key reused with different input, or archived task

get.summary: Accepted revisions in order
get.description: Each entry is the complete snapshot plus the actor; after is the last revision seen. Ordinary user tokens may call this route; writes are authorized per attempt against the task's owning project (user-scoped token or token issued for that project instance, plus a current grant), legacy writer tokens read only, admin tokens do everything.

400.description: Validation failure (bad cursor, limit or filter)

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

get.summary: Comments in append order
get.description: after is the last sequence seen; the cursor is stable while later comments arrive. Ordinary user tokens may call this route; writes are authorized per attempt against the task's owning project (user-scoped token or token issued for that project instance, plus a current grant), legacy writer tokens read only, admin tokens do everything.

400.description: Validation failure (bad cursor, limit or filter)

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

post.summary: Append an immutable Markdown comment
post.description: Body is {"body": <markdown>}; author and time are recorded by the service; the task revision is untouched. Refused on an archived task. Ordinary user tokens may call this route; writes are authorized per attempt against the task's owning project (user-scoped token or token issued for that project instance, plus a current grant), legacy writer tokens read only, admin tokens do everything. Retry keys travel in the Idempotency-Key header.

400.description: Validation failure (bounds, unknown field, missing Idempotency-Key, reserved project)

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

403.description: Credential may not write tasks in this project

409.description: Revision conflict (body carries current), idempotency key reused with different input, or archived task

get.summary: Read one comment
get.description: A comment under the wrong task is not found. Ordinary user tokens may call this route; writes are authorized per attempt against the task's owning project (user-scoped token or token issued for that project instance, plus a current grant), legacy writer tokens read only, admin tokens do everything.

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

Remove a grant by stored project-instance ID, including after project deletion

200.description: Grant absent; removal audited. Does not revoke tokens or change other grants.

post.summary: Issue an ordinary user token; admin issuance is host-console only

project.description: Existing project with contributor access; required for scope project, forbidden for user/read-only. Without scope, omit or empty retains legacy read-only behavior.

scope.description: User follows current direct/group grants on every write; project additionally restricts to one project instance; read-only never writes. Omitted scope preserves legacy project-or-read-only issuance.

expires_at.description: Future expiry, at most 366 days away

200.description: Ordinary token metadata including explicit scope, and secret shown once; response is no-store

400.description: Invalid fields; role/admin fields are never accepted

403.description: User lacks project access or is disabled

200.description: Revoked for subsequent requests; attribution retained

get.summary: List project ids
get.description: Also available to ordinary user tokens, which receive ordinary projects only; legacy writer and admin credentials receive every id when unfiltered. The optional tasks_enabled filter selects ordinary projects by Kanban enablement, regardless of task count, and excludes reserved stores for every credential. Unavailable project metadata fails the filtered request instead of silently omitting a project.

parameters.name: tasks_enabled
parameters.description: Filter ordinary projects by task enablement; true includes empty enabled boards. Omit for the existing general listing.

delete.summary: Drop a project (files deleted; a read never resurrects it)

post.summary: Rename a project: moves journal, facts, embeddings, curate cursor; relabels project:<id> citations in group DBs; refuses reserved ids and existing targets

Fold this project into an existing one ({into}) and remove it: events dedup on idempotency key, memories merge staleness-wins, runs id-idempotent, group citations relabel; refuses if the source holds docs/collections. For one project split across two ids
